final_prompt:
Write the text of an Ujjwal Rail helpdesk FAQ answer.
Document: FAQ-11 "Can I take my pet dog on the train?" (effective from 2025-06-01). Language: English.
Write each section below as 1-4 clear sentences for passengers, using ONLY the facts given.
Keep every number, amount, percentage, time, date and document ID exactly as given, using Western
digits (0-9) even in Hindi. Write dates in the YYYY-MM-DD form given. Do not add any other numbers,
rules, phone numbers, websites or contact details.
Sections (name: facts):
- "Answer": Only in a 1A coupe booked in full, with a vet certificate and a charge of Rs 500 per pet.
Schema: {"sections": [{"section": "<exact section name>", "text": str}]}

sections.text: You may travel with your pet dog only if you book a 1A coupe in full. You must present a valid veterinary certificate for the dog. A charge of Rs 500 per pet will be applied.
